construct: PKP2 encodes plakophilin-2, a desmosomal component of cardiomyocyte intercalated-disc junctions. Pathogenic PKP2 variants impair desmosomal integrity and mechanical coupling, contributing to ventricular arrhythmias and progressive fibrofatty myocardial replacement.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Exertional ventricular arrhythmia, family sudden death, right-ventricular fibrofatty replacement, and a pathogenic PKP2 variant identify arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy; plakophilin-2 is a desmosomal intercalated-disc protein.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Gap junctions, costameres, RyR2 calcium-release channels, and epithelial tight junctions are all real cellular structures, but none is the PKP2/plakophilin-2 desmosomal component implicated by the vignette.
